_about: Hugh Andrew Johnstone Munro (1819-1885), Cambridge Latinist. His English criticism; his Lucretius (text, notes, translation) is held elsewhere and not refetched. His Lucretius, fourth edition finally revised (Bell, 1886; 1900 printing): vol. I text with introduction and critical notes, vol. II explanatory notes, raw IA; vol. III, the translation, is on the lucretius shelf.

munro-pronunciation-latin-1871: A Few Remarks on the Pronunciation of Latin, with a postscript (1871)
munro-lucretius-1900-v1-text: T. Lucreti Cari De Rerum Natura Libri Sex, edited with notes and a translation, fourth edition finally revised, vol. I: Text, with introduction and critical notes (London: George Bell; Cambridge: Deighton Bell, 1900 printing of the 1886 edition); Latin text, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
munro-lucretius-1900-v2-notes: T. Lucreti Cari De Rerum Natura Libri Sex, fourth edition finally revised, vol. II: Explanatory Notes (London: George Bell; Cambridge: Deighton Bell, 1900 printing of the 1886 edition)

_excluded.Munro's Lucretius (1864-1886): vol. III, the translation, is on the lucretius shelf (lucretius-munro-translation, same 1900 printing); vols. I (text) and II (explanatory notes) are now on this shelf, added 2026-10-23
